title: Paul McCartney live at iHeartRadio Music Festival, Las Vegas
content:
Paul McCartney performed an eight-song set at the iHeartRadio Music Festival, at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas.

The show featured debut live performances of the songs ‘Save Us’, ‘Everybody Out There’ and ‘New’, from McCartney’s forthcoming album New.

McCartney had previously performed at the MGM Grand Garden Arena during the Driving World Tour on 5 and 6 April and 26 October 2002, and during the US Tour on 25 and 26 November 2005. He performed a private concert there for delegates attending the Hewlett-Packard Discover Americas trade conference on 9 June 2011, and the following night played there again for the Up And Coming Tour.

Concert setlist

  • ‘Magical Mystery Tour’
  • ‘Save Us’
  • ‘Let Me Roll It’
  • ‘Everybody Out There’
  • ‘Another Day’
  • ‘New’
  • ‘Lady Madonna’
  • ‘Live And Let Die’
